acceptanceCriteria: Default impact on a Zeitwerk-mapped file returns referencing callers and specs as advisory results (fixture FooClient -> Bar::BazService, foo_client_spec)
A second hop reaches the caller's spec (baz_service_spec)
reverse-import-rule-unavailable is not emitted for a path the autoload mapper resolves
Range impact (--base) attaches the same edges and ruby_autoload block
isTestPath classifies spec/**/_spec.rb as tests (closes V1-1700); NGI-V0 amended with new numbered requirements and tests
body: GitHub #1129 (tracked by #1130). Gap scan at 70a21da5d: ruby_autoload.go one-hop constant edges appear only with --language-profile non-go-syntax-v0 (impact.go:156, NGI-V0-020 opt-in); range impact passes nil (range_impact.go:311); non_go_impact.go:104 always emits reverse-import-rule-unavailable; results count as authoritative not advisory; isTestPath (impact.go:867) ignores spec/ and _spec.rb (V1-1700). Repro: Rails fixture FooClient / Bar::BazService; default impact on app/api_clients/foo_client.rb returns only itself. Expected: default impact reaches callers and specs referencing the constant, marked advisory, two hops. Extract the path<->constant mapper into a reusable package for the affected adapter (S2).
title: GH #1129 / #1130 S1: Ruby autoload constant impact by default, transitive and advisory, with range impact and spec/ test paths
